name: capabilities
notes: Issue #51 shell QA: the WKWebView capability truth table, measured by
RUNNING probes (never assumed) — media APIs (MediaRecorder mimes,
canvas.captureStream, WebCodecs under the non-secure app://local
origin), a LIVE record proving real frames reach the encoder (API
presence is not evidence: WebKit's WebGL captureStream black-frame
soft spot), the obShare bridge handoff end-to-end (share-log.json via
StatusSeam), and the touch-sheet Re-rack row (the toolbar-law fix).
The matrix artifact (capabilities.json) is printed + consistency-
checked by e2e-ios.mjs's capabilitiesReport assert. Simulator WebKit
may differ from device WebKit for media (hardware encoders) — the
report says so; the runbook carries the on-device recipe.
Boots obtool&seed=1 WITHOUT norec so record/export ARE wired
(fullrack precedent); SC-003 determinism boots stay ?norec elsewhere.
Issue #157: the matrix gains the transcode-leg DECODE probes
(VideoDecoder vp9/vp8, AudioDecoder opus, via __record.transcodeProbe)
and the photos-handoff routing assert is transcode-aware — webm +
transcode ok -> obPhotos; webm + transcode failed (the measured
simulator VideoToolbox zero-output stall is the EXPECTED sim verdict)
-> the share ladder + the honest record.prepareFailed notice. Device
column (transcode ok + live Photos write) re-owner at next install.

steps.js: (async () => { const cap = { origin: location.origin, secureContext: window.isSecureContext === true, ua: navigator.userAgent, mediaRecorder: typeof MediaRecorder !== 'undefined', mimes: {}, captureStream: typeof HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.captureStream === 'function', webcodecs: { videoEncoder: typeof VideoEncoder !== 'undefined', videoDecoder: typeof VideoDecoder !== 'undefined', videoFrame: typeof VideoFrame !== 'undefined', audioEncoder: typeof AudioEncoder !== 'undefined', audioDecoder: typeof AudioDecoder !== 'undefined' }, share: typeof navigator.share === 'function', canShare: typeof navigator.canShare === 'function', clipboard: !!navigator.clipboard, bridges: { obHaptics: !!window.webkit?.messageHandlers?.obHaptics, obShare: !!window.webkit?.messageHandlers?.obShare, obPhotos: !!window.webkit?.messageHandlers?.obPhotos }, record: { supported: window.__record?.supported === true, mime: window.__record?.mime ?? null, ext: window.__record?.ext ?? null }, exportTiers: null, exportSupport: null }; for (const m of ['video/webm', 'video/webm;codecs=vp9', 'video/webm;codecs=vp8', 'video/mp4', 'video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E,mp4a.40.2']) { cap.mimes[m] = cap.mediaRecorder && MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m); } try { if (window.__export) { await window.__export.open(); cap.exportSupport = window.__export.support(); cap.exportTiers = window.__export.tiers(); window.__export.close(); } } catch (e) { cap.exportSupport = 'probe failed: ' + e; } try { cap.transcodeProbe = window.__record?.transcodeProbe ? await window.__record.transcodeProbe() : null; } catch (e) { cap.transcodeProbe = 'probe failed: ' + e; } cap.probed = true; window.__cap = cap; return JSON.stringify(cap); })()

steps.note: record the live-capture evidence + a RENDERER-canvas pixel probe. body > canvas, NEVER querySelector('canvas'): the touch spin-pad canvas shadows it (measured trap — a blank 440x440 2D pad reads as an all-black 'renderer'). VideoFrame.copyTo is the proven same-task readback; drawImage is the no-WebCodecs fallback.
steps.js: (async () => { const cap = window.__cap ?? {}; cap.liveRecord = window.__record?.supported === true ? { exercised: true, bytes: window.__record.lastSize(), audioTracks: window.__record.audioTracks() } : { exercised: false }; cap.audioTap = !!(window.__sound && window.__sound.captureStream && window.__sound.captureStream()); try { const src = [...document.querySelectorAll('body > canvas')][0]; const t = Math.min(1, __test.duration() || 0); window.__test.renderAt(t); let lit = 0, sampled = 0; if (typeof VideoFrame !== 'undefined') { const f = new VideoFrame(src, { timestamp: 0 }); const size = f.allocationSize({ rect: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 64, height: 64 } }); const buf = new Uint8Array(size); await f.copyTo(buf, { rect: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 64, height: 64 } }); f.close(); sampled = size; for (let i = 0; i < buf.length; i++) { if (buf[i] > 24) lit++; } } else { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; c.height = 64; const cx = c.getContext('2d'); cx.drawImage(src, 0, 0, 64, 64); const d = cx.getImageData(0, 0, 64, 64).data; sampled = d.length; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { if (d[i] + d[i + 1] + d[i + 2] > 24) lit++; } } cap.canvasPixels = { sampled, lit, via: typeof VideoFrame !== 'undefined' ? 'videoframe' : 'drawimage' }; window.__test.setManual(false); } catch (e) { cap.canvasPixels = { error: String(e) }; try { window.__test.setManual(false); } catch (e2) {} } window.__cap = cap; return JSON.stringify(cap); })()
